title: 第七章 还抢收你们来了第八章 要么不杀要么杀绝
lines: “事实如此，我没夸张。”
黄良连忙解释。
“干你爹，太玄宗好歹也是堂堂修行宗门，难不成全是攀龙附凤之辈，老子就一条命，这么多人惦记着。”
林昊破口大骂，太他妈欺负人了。
把自己当成香烤熟的肥鸭子吗？
谁都想趴上来要两口。
太玄宗好歹也是大夏国内正儿八经的宗门，就算比不过凌家和大夏学宫这样的顶级势力，也不至于从上到下没个骨气吧。
“昊哥有所不知，如今的太玄宗，情况有些复杂。”
黄良道。
“详细说来。”
林昊咬牙，他倒要听听，为啥那么多人排成队干自己，凌家撅撅屁股就让那么多人跪着舔？
“咱们快些赶路吧，一边走一边说，我总觉得这一路不太平静。”
黄良道。
“站住。”
他话音刚落，前方突然传来一声大喝，就见五个身躯雄壮的汉子，手持明晃晃的兵器，在山路中间站成一排，把路堵了个严严实实。
“乌鸦嘴！”
林昊瞥了黄良一眼。
黄良表示自己很委屈，他只是说了一句不平静，立马冒出来几个拦路虎。
“玛德，是打劫的。”
“告诉他们我们是太玄宗弟子，让他们滚。”
林昊没好气的说道。
“大哥，他们是太玄宗的弟子。”
“很好，逮两只肥羊。”
几个劫匪一听是太玄宗弟子，脸上笑容更浓，大踏步径直走来。
领头的是个独眼，脸上还有一道斜着的刀疤，配合上他的笑容，狰狞可怖。
“那俩小子，给爷爷站那。”
独眼大喝，他浑身气势滚动，真气游荡，竟是一个气海境一重巅峰强者。
身边那四个，虽然没有达到气海境，但都在开脉九重。
这股战力，不可谓不强。
林昊有些发蒙，山林中常有劫匪，他是清楚的，但在云川这方地域，有敢打劫太玄宗弟子的劫匪吗？
林昊虽然没有离开过天宝城，但也知道，云川一代，太玄宗是唯一的修行宗门，是真正的大势力，各大城池的武道世家弟子，争着抢着跑太玄宗修行。
毫不夸张的说，太玄宗是云川不折不扣的庞然大物，岂是山林劫匪敢碰瓷的。
但现在，不对劲啊。
“昊哥，太玄宗不同往日了，今非昔比，我回头再给你详细解释，山林劫匪敢打劫太玄宗弟子，和太玄宗内干你的人排成队，原因是一样的。”
黄良连忙说道：“但现在，我们只有两条路，要么跟他们干，要么跑……”
黄良话还没说完，林昊已经冲出去了，整个人如离弦之箭，眨眼间来到独眼近前，一拳就砸在独眼胸膛之上。
哎呀！
那独眼发出一声哀嚎，二百斤的身体被一拳打飞出去，镶嵌在旁边的山体内，摆成一个大字，哇哇连喷几口夹杂着内脏的血，头一耷拉，没气了。
content_en:
"That's true, I'm not exaggerating."
Huang Liang explained quickly.
"Fuck you, Taixuanzong is also a cultivating sect after all. Could it be that they are all people who climb the dragon and follow the phoenix? I only have one life, so many people are thinking about it."
Lin Hao yelled, he was so fucking bullying.
Think of yourself as a roasted fat duck?
Everyone wants to get up and have a bite.
After all, Taixuan Sect is also a serious sect in Daxia. Even if it cannot compare with top powers like the Ling Family and Daxia Academy, it is not spineless from top to bottom.
"Brother Hao doesn't know. Today's situation in Taixuan Sect is a bit complicated."
Huang Liangdao.
"Tell me the details."
Lin Hao gritted his teeth. He wanted to hear why so many people lined up to fuck him. Why did the Ling family just let so many people kneel down to lick the Ling family's ass?
"Let's hurry up and talk as we go. I always feel that this journey is not peaceful."
Huang Liangdao.
"Stop."
As soon as he finished speaking, a loud shout suddenly came from the front, and he saw five majestic men, holding bright weapons, standing in a row in the middle of the mountain road, blocking the road tightly.
"Crow's Mouth!"
Lin Hao glanced at Huang Liang.
Huang Liang expressed that he was aggrieved. He just said that he was not calm, and several obstacles immediately appeared.
"Made, he was a robber."
"Tell them that we are disciples of Taixuan Sect and tell them to get lost."
Lin Hao said angrily.
"Brother, they are disciples of Taixuan Sect."
"Very good, catch two fat sheep."
When the robbers heard that they were disciples of Taixuan Sect, their smiles became even brighter and they strode straight towards them.
The leader was a one-eyed man with a slanted scar on his face. Combined with his smile, he looked ferocious and terrifying.
"Those two boys, stand there for grandpa."
One Eye shouted, his whole body was rolling with momentum, his true energy was wandering around, he was actually a peak powerhouse in the first level of the Qi Sea Realm.
Although the four around him have not reached the Qi Sea Realm, they are all at the ninth level of opening the pulse.
This fighting force is not weak.
Lin Hao was a little confused. He knew that there were often robbers in the mountains and forests, but in this area of ​​Yunchuan, were there any robbers who dared to rob Taixuan Sect disciples?
Although Lin Hao has never left Tianbao City, he also knows that in the Yunchuan generation, Taixuan Sect is the only practicing sect and is a truly powerful force. Disciples of martial arts families in major cities are vying to practice in Taixuan Sect.
It is no exaggeration to say that Taixuanzong is an out-and-out behemoth in Yunchuan. How can the forest robbers dare to touch him?
But now, something is wrong.
"Brother Hao, Taixuan Sect is different from the past. I will explain to you in detail later. The reason why the forest robbers dared to rob Taixuan Sect disciples and lined up with the people in Taixuan Sect to do you is the same."
Huang Liang said quickly: "But now, we only have two options, either fight with them or run away..."
Before Huang Liang finished speaking, Lin Hao had already rushed out. Like an arrow from a string, he came to Duyan in the blink of an eye and punched Duyan in the chest.
oops!
The one-eyed man let out a wail, and his 200-pound body was punched out. It was embedded in the mountain next to it, forming a big character. He spurted a few mouthfuls of blood mixed with internal organs, and his head drooped, lifeless.
title_en: Chapter 7: I’m here to snatch you away Chapter 8: Either don’t kill or kill them all
